purpose: Build/test interface contract only; never a runtime device or writable policy

rust_toolchain.note: The setup is a native Rust executable. Each architecture is built with cargo --release --locked on its native runner; x64 emulation is never used for ARM64.

package_builder.synthetic_older_fixture: Isolated clean worktree of the evaluated commit with only the CMake project version lowered; produces a complete 0.0.0 executable, version.json, payload archive and Rust setup. The evaluated checkout and its artifact hashes are unchanged.

acceptance_evidence.installed_metadata: Actual installed version.json, including clean production Release flags
acceptance_evidence.cases_format: Object: exact case name -> passed, failed, or skipped

installer_failure_injection.verify_stage_contract: The Apply action succeeds and a separate Verify action fails, exercising the verify rollback path

execution_scope: External tool execution authorized in isolated project tool directories; installer/service/VHD operations only on isolated CI, never on the local host or existing physical disks
